{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_crc32_d8 (
    input  wire [7:0]  data_in,
    input  wire [31:0] state_in,
    output wire [7:0]  data_out,
    output wire [31:0] state_out
);

    // Factor the matching data and low-state columns of the CRC matrix.
    wire [7:0] byte_mix;
    assign byte_mix = data_in ^ state_in[7:0];

    // Constant elaboration-time calculation of the reflected CRC matrix.
    // Each register holds a symbolic mask over byte_mix, not runtime state.
    function [7:0] crc_mask;
        input integer index;
        reg [7:0] s [0:31];
        reg [7:0] d [0:7];
        reg [7:0] feedback;
        integer i;
        integer j;
        begin
            for (j = 0; j < 32; j = j + 1)
                s[j] = 8'b0;
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
                feedback = s[0] ^ (8'b00000001 << i);
                d[i] = feedback;
                for (j = 0; j < 31; j = j + 1)
                    s[j] = s[j+1];
                s[31] = 8'b0;
                for (j = 0; j < 32; j = j + 1)
                    if ((32'hedb88320 >> j) & 32'b1)
                        s[j] = s[j] ^ feedback;
            end
            if (index < 32)
                crc_mask = s[index];
            else
                crc_mask = d[index-32];
        end
    endfunction

    genvar n;
    generate
        for (n = 0; n < 32; n = n + 1) begin : state_bits
            localparam [7:0] MASK = crc_mask(n);
            wire correction;
            assign correction = ^(byte_mix & MASK);
            if (n < 24) begin : shifted_state
                assign state_out[n] = state_in[n+8] ^ correction;
            end else begin : correction_only
                assign state_out[n] = correction;
            end
        end
        for (n = 0; n < 8; n = n + 1) begin : data_bits
            localparam [7:0] MASK = crc_mask(32+n);
            assign data_out[n] = ^(byte_mix & MASK);
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The original implementation independently reduces selected data and state bits for each output. Those expanded parity cones can incur excessive XOR depth and duplicate work, particularly when matching low-state and data contributions are not factored before mapping.",
  "rewrite": "Precompute byte_mix = data_in XOR state_in[7:0], then express both outputs as constant parity matrices over these eight signals. State outputs additionally include the untouched state_in >> 8 contribution. The masks are calculated at elaboration using reflected polynomial 0xedb88320; no runtime serial CRC chain or helper module is required.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The factored structure permits one initial XOR level, at most three balanced parity levels, and at most one final shifted-state XOR level. This should reduce maximum arrival if the reference mapping retains deeper expanded parity cones. Actual SKY130HD timing improvement requires mapping and STA; no measured gain is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Shares eight input XORs across all output cones and limits each correction parity to eight possible operands. This is expected to reduce duplicated XOR logic, although byte_mix fanout may require buffering. Compliance with the 2719.608320 um2 area cap and electrical constraints remains subject to implementation checks.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the fixed, parameterless pw_crc32_d8 interface and unsigned port widths. Implements eight LSB-first Galois CRC steps for arbitrary binary data_in and arbitrary state_in, without initialization assumptions, inversion, state, or latency. data_out contains the actual per-step feedback bits, including earlier-feedback contributions, rather than merely byte_mix. The symbolic arrays exist only inside a constant elaboration function and infer no memories. No latches, clocks, resets, assertions, or undefined outputs are introduced."
}
